start: HQ, a gym's page, no support access open

steps.action: Open the gym's access log (hq_access_log, newest 200 first)
user_sees: Rows with only when and what: sign_in, sign_out, sign_in_failed, push, pull_all
Counts per kind for the last 7 days
must_not: A person's name, device or address shown while no support access is open
Rows of another gym

steps.action: Look at the HQ audit log
user_sees: One 'view_access_log' row for this gym, with no reason
must_not: The look not written down

start: HQ, a gym with support access open (an emergency or the owner let support in)

steps.action: Open the same gym's access log
user_sees: 'detailed': true; each row also shows the person, the device and the address
must_not: The detail shown after the window ended

steps.action: Owner later opens 'ForgeAI access' in the admin app
user_sees: The look listed under the grant as 'access_log' with the number of rows
must_not: A detailed look that the owner cannot see

start: A caller that is not HQ (the admin app's anon key, a member app key)

steps.action: Call hq_access_log
user_sees: The call is refused (no execute right; _hq_guard)
must_not: Any row of the log returned
An audit row written as if HQ looked

start: HQ, a gym with support access that has just ended

steps.action: Open the access log while access is open
user_sees: Person, device and address shown
must_not: Detail missing while access is open

steps.action: Open it again after the window ends
user_sees: Only when and what again; 'detailed': false
must_not: Person, device or address still shown

steps.action: Open the access log with no support access
user_sees: No person, device or address
must_not: Personal data shown without a recorded window

steps.action: Check how long rows are kept
user_sees: 7 days until 13 May 2027, 1 year from then
must_not: Rows kept longer or shorter than the privacy notice says

start: A front-desk person signs in on a new phone

steps.action: A session row is made (gym_sessions insert)
user_sees: One 'sign_in' row: the person's name, device (80 letters at most) and address
must_not: No row written
A row in another gym

steps.action: The person signs out
user_sees: One 'sign_out' row for the same person
must_not: A second sign_in row on sign-out

start: The owner's admin app saves records, then a new phone pulls the whole copy

steps.action: crm_push moves the gym's record version
user_sees: One 'push' row with the person from crm_push
must_not: A push row for a member check-in or an offer reward

steps.action: crm_pull with p_since 0
user_sees: One 'pull_all' row; an old owner key shows 'Owner (old owner key)'
must_not: A pull_all row for a small pull (p_since above 0)

start: Someone types a wrong sign-in code

steps.action: A gym_signin_fails row is added
user_sees: One 'sign_in_failed' row: the person's name, or 'mobile ending 1234'
must_not: The full mobile number kept in the log
The sign-in allowed

start: A person signed in on two devices, then removed by the owner

steps.action: Owner removes the person
user_sees: A 'sign_out' row for each open session that ends
must_not: A session ending with no sign_out row

steps.action: Same session ended a second time
user_sees: No new row (only a change from open to ended writes)
must_not: Two sign_out rows for one session

steps.action: A row is written
user_sees: Only the gym's own id; the table has no app access (row-level security on, rights revoked)
must_not: Any app, owner or member reading the raw log
